g.title: depth_note
g.text: Why no depth retest at retirement?
Each supported primitive visits a pixel once.
Future primitive overlap needs a hazard policy.

g.title: trace
g.text: Per-edge accepted and retired tokens; batch cancellation during reset/recovery
Walker phase is not exclusive utilization of concurrent arithmetic/cache/shading blocks
Hardware activity counters overlap: do not sum them into elapsed clocks
System last_pass_cycles includes record fetch, tile DMA, drawing and memory waits
Trace IDs, scoreboards and CSV/JSON create no FPGA state or GPU memory ports

g.text: A younger ready entry waits for older work

40 DSP equivalents across full UV unit

g.text: Both U/V and error flags + context tag

g.title: miss
g.text: Freeze younger address and DSP stages
Older cache results drain in order
System: one owned Texture SDRAM slot
Pad final short-line tail without extra reads

g.title: read
g.text: Native B read → later output capture
7 enabled unit edges on hit TOTAL

g.title: context_read
g.text: ONE RGB565 result bank, shared with shade

g.title: resources
g.text: Renderer:14 BSRAM =3 tile +1 cache/copy +6 context +4 seed ROM
System:39 of46 BSRAM =renderer14 +2 scanout +5 host +1 reply +12 client slots +2 reader +3 row
46 of48 native18×18 equivalents =1 setup +40 UV +2 texture address +3 RGB
The selected schedule permits overlap; misses/backpressure/context exhaustion cause bubbles.
Core/SDRAM100.8MHz is a configurable assumption. Whole-GPU fit and achieved timing are not established.
Old serial divider /14-edge texture-hit APIs remain standalone oracles, outside selected GPU execution.
